_text: [fast-paced, energetic storyteller] You haven't slept in twenty-nine days, and your toaster just told you to relax. [dramatic] Because twenty-nine days ago, the sun stopped in the sky... and never set again. [excited] At first, it's AWESOME. Kids skip bedtime. Your dad mows the lawn eleven times. [quick] But your brain only makes its sleepy juice in the *dark*. [dramatic] So nobody sleeps, and darkness becomes the most expensive thing on *Earth*. [amused] A closet rents for nine-hundred-dollars a night. Movie theaters turn into hotels. [amused] And a guy in Ohio sleeps in his FRIDGE. [playful] Your neighbor Kyle paints his basement black, and sells night for five-hundred-dollars an hour.
